name: Bright Real Estate Group Co.,Limited
summary: Bright Real Estate Group Co., Limited primarily engages in the development of both residential and commercial properties throughout China. Beyond its core real estate endeavors, the enterprise also operates in the logistics sector and provides construction engineering services. Its extensive business portfolio further includes a range of operational activities such as project construction, strategic planning and market placement, investment and rental management, sales representation, real estate asset exchange, property management financing, and direct property oversight. Additionally, the company is involved in the complete lifecycle of building materials like aluminum alloys and plastic-steel doors and windows, from design and processing to production and installation. The firm's principal location is in Shanghai, China.
